body.name: Armwise completion witness
body.construction: For \(f_{a,z}\in\mathcal S_{a,z}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), set \(q_{a,z}(r)=f_{a,z}(r)/u_{a,z}(r)\) on \(\{u_{a,z}>0\}\) and \(q_{a,z}(r)=0\) on \(\{u_{a,z}=0\}\). Conditional on \(X=(z,r)\), draw \((\widetilde T_a,\Delta_a)\) independently across arms from \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}((\widetilde T,\Delta)\in\cdot\mid A=a,X=(z,r))\). If \(\Delta_a=0\), set \(T(a)=\widetilde T_a\) and \(C(a)=t_{\max}+1\). If \(\Delta_a=1\), set \(C(a)=\widetilde T_a\) and set \(T(a)=t_{\max}\) with probability \(q_{a,z}(r)\), otherwise \(T(a)=\widetilde T_a\). Finally draw \(A\) independently given \(X\) with probabilities \(\pi_a(X)\); the resulting law is \(P^f\).
